title: When Charts Deceive Web Agents: A Paired Benchmark for Misleading Visualization-Grounded Tasks
reasons: 未找到 LLM / Agent 评测对象与基准主题的共同证据
missingSignals: 材料中提供代码或数据链接（未核验内容）

evidence.label: 明确提出新的评测资料或框架
evidence.excerpt: We introduce MisVisAgentBench, the first paired executable benchmark for evaluating how misleading visualizations affect Web Agent execution.

evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: In many realistic workflows, however, the visual evidence they consume is not neutral: charts and dashboards can be misleading, shaping judgments without issuing any explicit malicious instruction.

evidence.label: 描述评分指标或评测协议
evidence.excerpt: Across thirteen vision-language Web Agents, replacing clean charts with misleading counterparts reduces the average task success rate by more than 34 percentage points.

evidence.label: 报告基线或多个模型的评测
evidence.excerpt: We further provide a diagnostic framework that isolates misleading-induced failures from baseline task difficulty (Zhu et al., 2025) and captures execution-level effects such as extra browsing steps and decision hesitation.

evidence.label: 给出任务规模或覆盖范围
evidence.excerpt: It comprises 280 task instances in matched clean--misleading pairs that differ only in chart evidence.

evidence.label: 讨论泛化、污染、稳健性或人工核验
evidence.excerpt: These results reveal that visualization robustness is a critical yet understudied dimension of Web Agent safety and reliability.
